reviewer: ChatGPT; same-agent review, not independent expert certification

method.baseline: All 299 RC2 pages were individually rendered and visually read at 110 dpi with MuPDF.
method.revision: All 83 non-version changed pages were visually rechecked in readable crops or full pages. Uniform version replacements were programmatically checked on every page and visually spotchecked.
method.preservation: 299-page 96-dpi RGB regression outside the union of old/new changed-text rectangles (1.5pt antialias margin): zero differing pixels. All nontext drawing geometry and colors exactly equal RC2.
method.second_renderer: Poppler full-page cross-check at 110 dpi on the listed 41 pages; all 22 comparison/recall/migration pages and all 4 special-form index pages included.
method.grayscale: MuPDF DeviceGray simulation on four representative pages, not a physical paper test.
method.attachment_binding: Per-page RGB96 hashes bind the reviewed page rendering. Adding this record does not alter the pages. The pre-attachment file SHA256 is separately recorded; no circular self-hash is claimed.

grayscale_result: Text and grids remain readable in screen simulation; new red strokes and prior dark-gray strokes have reduced tonal separation. Color printing is recommended; use sequence numbers and adjacent frames when reading in grayscale.
implementation_findings_closed: Text redaction initially intersected ten migration return-link rectangles; exact original annotation dictionaries were restored before final validation. All 50 link targets and rectangles now match RC2.
Replacing only the repeated single-step token left excessive whitespace; the complete p282 subtitle was reflowed and visually rechecked.
